build_qadailymail_data: run the build function to download and prepare the QADailyMail dataset for training
create_default_teacher: create a DefaultTeacher instance to load the QADailyMail QA dataset in ParlAI format
get_datafile_path: call the _path function to resolve the QADailyMail data file path for a given datatype
review_default_teacher_init: review the DefaultTeacher class __init__ method to understand how opt and datafile are configured
refactor_default_teacher: refactor the DefaultTeacher class to extend a newer ParlAI teacher base class instead of FbDeprecatedDialogTeacher
